query:
SELECT
            queue                                            AS "queue!",
            SUM((status = 'pending')::int)::bigint           AS "pending!",
            SUM((status = 'running')::int)::bigint           AS "running!",
            SUM((status = 'succeeded')::int)::bigint         AS "succeeded!",
            SUM((status = 'failed')::int)::bigint            AS "failed!",
            SUM((status = 'dead')::int)::bigint              AS "dead!"
        FROM jobs
        GROUP BY queue
        ORDER BY queue
